title: Explaining Hate Speech Classification with Model-Agnostic Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Using the LIME interpretability framework to analyze feature importance and determine whether the model classifies tweets as 'Hate' primarily based on the presence of race-related stem words and slurs (e.g., 'black', 'white', etc.).

Using the LIME interpretability framework to extract feature importance and analyze whether the model categorizes tweets as 'Offensive' specifically due to the presence of gender-related or sexist stem words and slurs.

Evaluating whether the hate speech detection model over-relies on specific offensive keywords (spurious correlations) rather than analyzing the broader context of the sentence, verified through post-hoc model-agnostic explanations (LIME).
